title: Transfer Claims-Experience Share Schedule, Harbison Parts-and-Labor Protection Tiers
content:
On a home-sale transfer of a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, a claims-experience share applies by multiplication to the open benefit carried to the buyer. It is set by the number of claims on the seller's contract whose original decision approved or partially approved them within the thirty-six calendar months before the date of handling, read from the seller's claim history.

| Claims approved or partially approved on their original decision in the 36 months | Transfer claims-experience share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.85 |
| exactly one | 0.95 |
| none | 1 |

**Points of reading.**

- A claim whose original decision was a denial does not count.
- An original decision posted more than 36 calendar months before the date of handling does not count.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** The seller's contract shows an approved claim 10 months before the date of handling, a partially approved claim 40 months before it and a denied claim 5 months before it. Only the first counts: share 0.95.
